Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We attached our completed CAIQ export (CSV) but ran a quick pass and flagged a few items that look inconsistent with our deployment model: NovuHealth is running on a Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) under our contract, but multiple CAIQ answers and referenced evidence point to "shared hosted" assumptions (notably around KMS rotation cadence and tenant-bound runtime logs).

Can you confirm:
- Which control entries do you map to our dedicated capacity (especially key management and network segregation controls)?
- Where will you provide a provenance/log sample that demonstrates tenant-specific KV/cache isolation for a 30-day window?
- Do you have an auditable key-rotation artifact for our private KMS integration (we need the rotation schedule + signed attestations)?

We'd like to get this packaged for our internal auditors next week. I've attached the CSV we exported from the CAIQ portal (novu_caiq_inventory.csv) and highlighted the rows we think need clarification.

Attachments: novu_caiq_inventory.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Security Manager, NovuHealth
security@novuhealth.com

Note: please keep the scope limited to controls scoped to NovuHealth tenancy. We can exchange DocuSign for PO/credits with Procurement (cc'ed).

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Lina — thanks for the export and the clear flags. We're on this. High-level plan and asks: 

1) Mapping & immediate clarifications (this week) — Priya will do the control crosswalk to indicate the authoritative Redwood artifact for each CAIQ assertion that applies to Dedicated capacity. Expect a table with three columns: CAIQ question, Redwood control mapping, artifact reference (doc name + link).

2) Provenance/log sample — we can produce a 30-day sampled log for tenant-specific cache/KV evictions and API keys usage. Note: the sample will be redacted for other tenants but will show time-stamped events, request IDs, and the tenant_id hash used in the isolation boundary. We will provide the log as redwood_kv_cache_sample.log (CSV-style lines).

3) KMS rotation artifacts — Priya, can you attach the rotation attest and the HSM KMS export? We normally provide a signed rotation summary (rotation-manifest.pdf) plus an operational playbook describing how keys are rolled across Dedicated pools. Marissa — will coordinate secure transfer (S3 pre-signed + permissions) and the DocuSign if Procurement needs it.

Proposed timeline:
- Fri EOD PST: initial crosswalk draft (Priya)
- Mon noon PST: redacted log sample upload (Marissa)
- Tue: rotation manifest and signed attestation (if we can push cert to the portal)

Please confirm the specific CAIQ rows you marked as "scope variance" (we'll take whatever list you sent in the CSV). Also confirm the contact for evidence intake (is the security@novuhealth.com mailbox the primary ingest?).

Attachments: none (we received your CSV).

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, lina.gomez@novuhealth.com
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ submission + scope variance (NovuHealth production)

Mateo / Lina — attaching the crosswalk summary for the rows called out in the CSV. Short answers inline here while you review the attachment: 

- KMS / Key rotation (CAIQ control: CRYPTO-KEY-ROTATION / related to CMA/3.1): Redwood uses a customer-specific key alias in the cloud KMS for Dedicated customers. Rotation cadence: 90 days by policy; emergency rotations executed as required. The rotation manifest includes timestamps, rotation-trigger reason codes, and a signed HSM thumbprint. We will publish the manifest as evidence_key_rotation.pdf.

- Tenant-bound telemetry (CAIQ control: LOG-ISOLATION / related to IA/2): Dedicated pools write logs with tenant_id prefixes and separate object prefixes in s3 buckets with bucket policies restricting read to our tenancy role. The redwood_kv_cache_sample.log will include pseudonymized tenant_id values (sha256 truncated) and request IDs for traceability.

- Network segregation (CAIQ control: NET-SEG): Dedicated nodes are placed in a customer-designated subnet with security groups and VPC routing rules that prevent cross-tenant traffic. We will reference the infra template (dedicated_vpc_template.yml) in the crosswalk.

Notes on evidence format: we can provide PDF manifests, redacted log samples (.log), and a short narrative per control. If auditors need signed attestations, we can produce a notarized manifest signed by our Security Ops lead.

I will: 
- Upload evidence_key_rotation.pdf to a restricted S3 folder and share a pre-signed link to NovuHealth security mailbox.
- Generate the redwood_kv_cache_sample.log with 10 days of events (if they want 30 days we need approval for data egress window; let's clarify).

Marissa — can you prepare the pre-signed upload path and the access ACL that will be granted to lina.gomez@novuhealth.com?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Staff Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

Attachment: evidence_key_rotation.pdf (signed rotation manifest, 2 pages)
